body.html:

articles.title: Son Beats Ailing Mother on Camera: US-Based Daughter Exposes Abuse in Ghaziabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad: A shocking case of elder abuse has surfaced from Ghaziabad, where a son was caught on CCTV brutally assaulting his old and ailing mother inside their home.

body.html:
Ghaziabad: A shocking case of elder abuse has surfaced from Ghaziabad, where a son was caught on CCTV brutally assaulting his old and ailing mother inside their home. The disturbing incident came to light after the victim’s daughter, who lives in the United States, accessed the CCTV footage installed in her mother’s room and handed it over to the police.

The incident is reported from Jagriti Vihar Colony in Sanjay Nagar Sector-23, under the Madhuban Bapudham police station area. The accused has been identified as Nishant Thakur, who lives with his elderly mother at house number 22 in the colony.

According to the footage, Nishant is seen pulling his mother’s hair, trying to throw her off the bed, throwing away her medicines, and repeatedly punching her. The woman appears too weak to defend herself. The video has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread outrage.

Nishant’s sister, Nisha, who resides in the US, had installed the CCTV camera to monitor her mother’s health and wellbeing from abroad. However, upon witnessing repeated assaults by her brother, she decided to make the footage public to expose the abuse and seek justice for her mother.

Local residents said Nishant often misbehaved with his mother, but they were unaware of the extent of the violence. After the video surfaced, residents demanded strict action against the accused.

Police said the CCTV footage has been received and is being examined. Legal proceedings have been initiated, and the safety and condition of the elderly woman are being closely monitored.

The incident has shocked the public and reignited concerns over the safety of elderly parents living with abusive family members.

articles.title: Ambulance Never Came: Pregnant Woman Delivers Baby on Roadside Under Mobile Light in Vidisha
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Vidisha: In a shocking incident highlighting gaps in emergency healthcare, a pregnant woman delivered her baby on a roadside in Vidisha after an ambulance failed to arrive despite repeated calls. A video of the incident has surfaced and is being widely shared.

body.html:
Vidisha: In a shocking incident highlighting gaps in emergency healthcare, a pregnant woman delivered her baby on a roadside in Vidisha after an ambulance failed to arrive despite repeated calls. A video of the incident has surfaced and is being widely shared.

The incident occurred on Thursday night in Chapara village under the Pathari area. The Community Health Centre, from where the ambulance was called, is located just three kilometres from the village.

Sandhya, wife of Sanjay Adivasi and a resident of Chapara village, went into labour around midnight. Her family repeatedly contacted the 108 ambulance service and Janani Express, but each time they were assured the vehicle would arrive shortly. Despite waiting for hours, no ambulance reached the village.

As Sandhya’s condition worsened, the family decided to walk her to the hospital. Near the ration shop in Garhi Mohalla, her labour pain intensified, and she could not move further. She was laid on the roadside and covered with a plastic tarpaulin.

Under the open sky on a cold night, Sandhya’s husband stood holding a mobile phone torch for light, while a small stove was lit to keep her warm. Pathari village watchwoman Hari Bai reached the spot and, realising the seriousness of the situation, called local midwife Rajbai. Together, they assisted the delivery on the roadside.

The mother and newborn remained on the roadside for nearly three hours. Later, a local resident, Sanjay Jain, arrived and took them to the hospital in his car. Both mother and baby were admitted, and their condition is reported to be stable.

Sanjay Adivasi said he had called the ambulance three times, with each call kept on hold for about 15 minutes. He said that had the ambulance arrived on time, his wife would not have had to endure labour on the roadside.

Attempts by Dainik Bhaskar to seek a response from the staff of the Community Health Centre reportedly drew no reply.

#Vidisha #AmbulanceFailure #HealthcareCrisis #RoadsideDelivery #MPNews #RuralIndia #JananiExpress #108Ambulance #IndiaNews

articles.title: Homework Horror: Bengaluru Teacher Accused of Brutally Beating Class 4 Student
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru: A case has been registered at the Nandini Layout police station against a private school teacher for allegedly assaulting a Class 4 student for not completing his homework. The incident reportedly took place at Veena School in Laggere Lakshmidevinagar.

body.html:
Bengaluru: A case has been registered at the Nandini Layout police station against a private school teacher for allegedly assaulting a Class 4 student for not completing his homework. The incident reportedly took place at Veena School in Laggere Lakshmidevinagar.

The complaint has been filed by the victim’s mother against teacher Angelina and the school’s Human Resources (HR) officer. Based on the complaint, police have issued a notice to the teacher, asking her to appear for questioning.

According to the mother, her son, who studies in Class 4 and stays at a hostel near Laggere, was beaten by the teacher on January 10. She alleged that the teacher assaulted the child on his hands and legs, leaving visible bruises, and threatened to strangle and kill him if he informed his parents about the incident. The child reportedly suffered severe pain following the assault.

The mother said she visited the school on January 12, when her son broke down and narrated the ordeal. She then informed the school’s HR department, which summoned the teacher. However, she alleged that no strict disciplinary action was taken.

The child is said to be traumatised by the incident and has refused to return to school. According to the mother, he lives in constant fear that the teacher is still present at the school and may assault him again. She claimed her son told her, “I will die if you force me to go to school.”

The mother has demanded strict action against the teacher for assaulting her minor son and against the HR officer for alleged negligence in handling the matter. Police said further investigation is underway.

#Bengaluru #SchoolAbuse #StudentSafety #TeacherAccused #Laggere #ChildRights #EducationNews #IndiaNews

articles.title: Held Captive for 3 Weeks: Pastor Accused of Detaining Woman, Nihangs Step In After Police Inaction
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ludhiana/Khanna: A pastor in Punjab’s Ludhiana district has been accused of illegally confining a woman at his house for nearly three weeks on the pretext of taking her to church.

body.html:
Ludhiana/Khanna: A pastor in Punjab’s Ludhiana district has been accused of illegally confining a woman at his house for nearly three weeks on the pretext of taking her to church. The incident came to light in Khanna after the woman’s family alleged police inaction and sought help from Nihangs to rescue her.

According to the family, the incident began on January 7 when Pastor Raman Kumar took the woman from her home, claiming he would take her to attend a church service. However, instead of dropping her back, he allegedly kept her confined in a room at his house and also took her to Ludhiana during this period.

Family members alleged that the woman was not allowed to move freely, meet anyone in private, and was subjected to mental harassment. They said their suspicion grew as they were repeatedly denied direct access to her.

The family further claimed they submitted a written complaint to the police on January 9, but no effective action was taken. A relative alleged that repeated requests to the police were ignored, allowing the confinement to continue.

Tensions escalated on Tuesday when the woman’s mother managed to meet her briefly in Khanna. The meeting reportedly lasted about two minutes and took place in the presence of others. During the interaction, the woman allegedly signalled that she was being held against her will.

Following this, the family approached members of the Nihangs for help. Jathedar Sarabjit Singh Khalsa of the Taruna Dal said that after hearing the family’s account, he and a group of Nihangs went to the pastor’s house and intervened, bringing the woman out safely.

After the incident drew public attention, police reached the spot and detained Pastor Raman Kumar for questioning. The woman’s father said he had visited the police station multiple times over the past three weeks and alleged that the rescue was possible only after external intervention.

Khanna DSP Vinod Kumar confirmed that a case has been registered against the pastor and that an investigation is underway. He said strict action would be taken after verifying all facts. Police also stated that the woman is safe and that her statement will be crucial to the probe.

#Ludhiana #Khanna #PunjabNews #IllegalDetention #PastorAccused #PoliceInaction #Nihangs #WomenSafety #IndiaNews

articles.title: ATM Turns Crime Scene: Man Shot, ₹6 Lakh Looted in Hyderabad Morning Heist
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad: CCTV footage has surfaced in a shocking robbery incident in which a man was shot and ₹6 lakh was looted near the SBI main branch ATM in Koti on Friday morning.

body.html:
Hyderabad: CCTV footage has surfaced in a shocking robbery incident in which a man was shot and ₹6 lakh was looted near the SBI main branch ATM in Koti on Friday morning.

The incident occurred around 7 am when Rashid (also reported as Rishad) arrived at the ATM on his scooter to deposit cash. According to police, the accused followed him and attempted to threaten him into handing over the money. When he resisted, the assailants snatched the cash and shot him in the leg.

The accused fled the spot on the victim’s scooter after the firing. Two bullets were reportedly recovered from the scene. Rashid sustained a bullet injury to his leg and was immediately shifted to a hospital for treatment.

Police have launched an investigation and are examining the CCTV footage from the ATM and nearby areas to identify the attackers.

articles.title: Triple Murder Shock: Son Kills Parents, Sister, Buries Bodies at Home, Then Files ‘Missing’ Complain
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bengaluru/Kotturu: In a chilling case, the Tilak Nagar police in Bengaluru have taken into custody a 24-year-old man accused of murdering three members of his own family in Kotturu village of Vijayanagara district, Karnataka.

body.html:
Bengaluru/Kotturu: In a chilling case, the Tilak Nagar police in Bengaluru have taken into custody a 24-year-old man accused of murdering three members of his own family in Kotturu village of Vijayanagara district, Karnataka.

The deceased have been identified as father Bhimraj (50), mother Jayalakshmi (45) and younger sister Amrutha (18). The accused is Akshay Kumar, who was living with his family and running a tyre shop in the village.

According to police, Akshay allegedly murdered his parents and sister on the night of January 26, buried their bodies inside the house, and fled to Bengaluru. After reaching the city, he went to the Tilak Nagar police station and filed a complaint claiming that his family members were missing.

Police officers grew suspicious of Akshay’s behaviour during questioning. During interrogation, he reportedly confessed to killing his father, mother and sister. A case has been registered at the Tilak Nagar police station, and the accused has been arrested.

The Bengaluru police have informed the Vijayanagara district police, and Akshay will be handed over to them for further investigation. A team from the Vijayanagara police has visited the crime scene and conducted an inspection.

Police said investigations are ongoing to ascertain the exact motive behind the triple murder.

#KarnatakaCrime #TripleMurder #FamilyKilled #Vijayanagara #BengaluruPolice #CrimeNews #ShockingCrime #IndiaNews

articles.title: Hit, Dragged, Filmed: E-Rickshaw Driver Hung on Jeep Bonnet in Broad Daylight
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jagran, Bilaspur: A shocking incident was reported from the Nainital Highway in Bilaspur, where a jeep driver dragged an e-rickshaw driver by hanging him on the bonnet of his vehicle. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
Jagran, Bilaspur: A shocking incident was reported from the Nainital Highway in Bilaspur, where a jeep driver dragged an e-rickshaw driver by hanging him on the bonnet of his vehicle. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the incident occurred around 10 am on Wednesday at the Kemri intersection on the Nainital Highway. A speeding jeep collided head-on with an e-rickshaw coming from the opposite direction, causing the e-rickshaw to overturn. The driver of the e-rickshaw, Shabbu, a resident of Bhatpura Taran village, sustained injuries and started bleeding from the nose.

After the collision, the jeep driver attempted to flee the spot. When the injured e-rickshaw driver tried to stop him by standing in front of the jeep, the driver allegedly pulled him onto the bonnet and dragged him for about 50 metres towards Rampur Road.

Eyewitnesses said that despite people raising an alarm, the jeep driver continued driving and even spun the vehicle in circles, leaving the injured man hanging with his legs on the bonnet.
The jeep was finally stopped after a crowd gathered and protested, saving the e-rickshaw driver. Several bystanders recorded the incident on their mobile phones, and the video soon surfaced online.

On receiving information, Kotwali police reached the spot and detained the jeep driver. However, the police reportedly kept the matter under wraps for the entire day. The accused was later challaned for disturbing the peace.

Inspector-in-charge Balwan Singh identified the jeep driver as Manpreet Singh, a resident of Mohalla Sant Colony in the city. Following a compromise between both parties, the accused was charged under breach of peace sections, produced before the SDM court, and later released on bail.

Reacting to the incident, Prem Naresh Valmiki, president of the Rashtriya Garib Kalyan Sangh, said he was aware of the case. He clarified that the injured e-rickshaw driver was not associated with the union linked to his organisation, but assured that help would be provided if the victim approached them.

articles.title: Reel Turns Fatal: Slab Crushes 22-Year-Old to Death at Bareilly Flyover
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic accident occurred near the under-construction flyover on the road leading to Bijouria railway station in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, where a young man died while making a social media reel. The deceased has been identified as Mohammad Faizan (22), a resident of Richhola village.

body.html:
A tragic accident occurred near the under-construction flyover on the road leading to Bijouria railway station in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, where a young man died while making a social media reel.

The deceased has been identified as Mohammad Faizan (22), a resident of Richhola village. He worked as a hair cutter. According to eyewitnesses, several concrete slabs were kept along the roadside near the under-construction flyover. At around 5 pm, Faizan climbed onto these slabs to record a reel when his foot slipped. He fell uncontrollably, and one of the slabs also slipped and fell on his head, killing him on the spot.

Police reached the spot soon after the incident and informed the family. The family declined a postmortem examination and took the body home.

Faizan’s father, Mehndi Hasan, said his son had left home around 5 pm to go for a walk with his friend Anuj. Shortly afterwards, the family received news of his death. Faizan’s brothers—Husne Mustafa, Noor Mustafa, Zeeshan and Uvaish—and his two sisters are inconsolable following the incident.

articles.title: Jabalpur: Speeding Car Flattens Power Pole, Accident Hotspot Claims Yet Again
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A high-speed car crashed into a power pole in Jabalpur early Thursday morning, once again highlighting the danger of the Bilhari–Tilhari stretch, which has seen repeated accidents.

body.html:
A high-speed car crashed into a power pole in Jabalpur early Thursday morning, once again highlighting the danger of the Bilhari–Tilhari stretch, which has seen repeated accidents. The incident occurred around 5 am when the car, travelling from Jabalpur towards Barela, lost control and rammed into the pole with such force that it was uprooted.

The driver narrowly escaped serious injury as the car’s airbag deployed in time. A video of the accident has since surfaced on social media. Following the crash, the damaged power pole led to a power outage in the surrounding area.

Police from Gora Bazaar police station reached the spot after receiving information, seized the vehicle, and launched a search for the driver, who was not found at the scene. The car involved in the accident bears registration number MP 20 ZA 9922.

The Bilhari–Tilhari area has emerged as a major accident hotspot, with mishaps being reported almost daily. Earlier, on January 8, a similar incident was reported in the Bilhari area when a speeding car rammed into a roadside shop late at night. No casualties were reported in that case, and Dial 112 police reached the spot. No formal complaint was filed as the matter was settled mutually between the driver and the shop owner.

#JabalpurAccident #SpeedingCar #AccidentHotspot #RoadSafety #MPNews #PowerPoleCrash #BilhariTilhari #EarlyMorningCrash
